review_description: Highly recommend Solar Fix. Dave was recommended by my electrician. He was fantastic to work with. Great to have the same guy come to the site, provide quote, book the job and also do most of the actual installation. Installed a 40kwh Sigenstor with new 10kw inverter backup gateway as well as an extra 5.61kw of panels to compliment our existing 7.8kw system. So far everything working well with no issues. Great installer to work with and very competitive on price compared to some other companies.
Asked for one supplementary panel to be replaced to complete our system but never received a response.Sales  - 0Installation - ?Customer service - 0

I gained 7 quotes and requested they all quote on a 8.2kw Fronius inverter and QCells 410w panels. There was a range of quotes from $9,300 to $13,800. I did my research over the last 18 months on panels and inverter and this is why I selected these brands. Dave from Solarfix was not only excellent on service and upfront with all steps in the process, but his quote was by far the best. And we got a larger solar panel system. 9.73kw.I would highly recommend Solarfix as a quality installer.
